key_results: Simple signaling model captures CD69 surface expression frequency response (high-pass, low-pass, band-pass, band-stop) with accuracy within experimental error; band-pass explained by desensitization, band-stop by removal-inhibition circuits
comments: The trade-off between interpretability and accuracy is addressed elegantly through constrained functional relaxation, but the approach's generalizability to other biological systems remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Simple arrow-diagram constrained models can achieve both quantitative accuracy and interpretability for cellular dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model validated on independent datasets from multiple labs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Band-pass and band-stop behaviors arise from specific circuit motifs (desensitization vs. removal-inhibition)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; distinct mechanistic explanations mapped to specific model components

title: Adhesion-driven rigidity transition decoupled from density-driven jamming triggers epithelial organization in embryonic tissues
task: Decouple adhesion-driven rigidity from density-driven jamming in tissue morphogenesis
key_results: Adhesion, not density, is the main determinant of tissue rheology; adhesion-driven rigidification in unjammed tissue triggers epithelial organization via tricellular junctions, lumenogenesis, and apical polarity initiation
comments: The elegant experimental decoupling via optogenetics reveals that nonlinear mechanics can reprogram morphogenesis independently of classical jamming transitions, challenging existing paradigms of tissue organization.

outputs: epithelial markers (tricellular junctions, lumenogenesis, apical polarity)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell density and adhesion perform redundant functions in tissue rigidity
hypotheses.result: Rejected; adhesion is decoupled and acts as primary rheological determinant

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adhesion-driven rigidification in unjammed tissue is sufficient to trigger epithelial organization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mechanical transition initiates morphogenetic program switch via tricellular junction formation

title: 4E-BP1 acts as a molecular rheostat balancing regenerative healing and fibrotic scarring
task: Characterize 4E-BP1 as molecular rheostat balancing wound healing and fibrotic scarring
key_results: 4E-BP1 ablation enhances re-epithelialization, angiogenesis, granulation tissue formation but promotes myofibroblast activation and excessive collagen deposition; sustained 4E-BP1 overexpression impairs wound closure and attenuates fibrosis; elevated phosphorylated 4E-BP1 in human fibrotic scars
comments: The dual role of 4E-BP1 in simultaneously promoting healing and fibrosis suggests context-dependent or cell-type-specific regulation that merits further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4E-BP1 acts as mTORC1 effector regulating translation during tissue repair
hypotheses.result: Phosphorylated 4E-BP1 is markedly increased in wound and fibrotic tissues; 4E-BP1 governs TGF-β1-mediated fibroblast collagen synthesis

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4E-BP1 balances reparative efficiency and fibrotic remodeling
hypotheses.result: 4E-BP1 ablation enhances wound healing but promotes fibrosis; sustained overexpression impairs healing and attenuates fibrosis

title: C/EBPγ induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition and facilitates DNA double-strand break repair in lung adenocarcinoma cells
task: Identify C/EBPγ as EMT inducer and link EMT to DNA repair capacity
key_results: C/EBPγ induces mesenchymal morphology and EMT gene expression; leucine zipper domain (not DNA-binding) is essential; C/EBPγ promotes XRCC6 recruitment to DSB sites and enhances NHEJ activity
comments: The DNA-binding-independent mechanism via protein-protein interactions is novel, but the link between EMT and chemoresistance remains correlative rather than causally demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: C/EBPγ induces EMT through interaction with C/EBPβ antagonism
hypotheses.result: RNAi knockdown attenuates EMT; domain mapping shows leucine zipper domain requirement

hypotheses.hypothesis: C/EBPγ enhances NHEJ-mediated DSB repair
hypotheses.result: C/EBPγ promotes XRCC6 recruitment to DSB sites and increases survival under etoposide treatment

title: A Rras2–BMPR2 feedback loop sustains osteogenesis and represents a therapeutic target for osteoporosis
task: Characterize Rras2 role in bone homeostasis and osteogenesis
key_results: Rras2 deficiency causes osteopenia and impaired osteogenesis; Rras2 blocks Smurf1-dependent BMPR2 degradation; AAV9-mediated Rras2 restoration rescues bone loss in osteoporotic mice
comments: The positive feedback loop between Rras2 and BMP signaling is mechanistically elegant and provides a clear therapeutic target, though in vivo validation is limited to mouse models.

model_io.model: AAV9-mediated Rras2 restoration in osteoporotic mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rras2 sustains BMP signaling by blocking BMPR2 degradation
hypotheses.result: Rras2 prevents Smurf1-dependent ubiquitination and degradation of BMPR2; BMP signaling reciprocally enhances Rras2 transcription

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rras2 deficiency recapitulates Noonan syndrome skeletal features
hypotheses.result: Rras2-deficient mice exhibit osteopenia, reduced bone strength, and impaired osteogenesis

title: Nucleophagy removes cytotoxic trapped PARP1
task: Elucidate nucleophagy as cytoprotective clearance mechanism for trapped PARP1
key_results: TEX264 and p97 orchestrate nucleophagic clearance of trapped PARP1; TEX264 directly interacts with trapped PARP1 and links it to LC3 for degradation; disrupting nucleophagy increases PARP1 trapping and re-sensitizes PARPi-resistant cells
comments: The cytoprotective role of nucleophagy in PARPi resistance is counterintuitive to sensitivity goals but provides a rational strategy for overcoming resistance.

model_io.model: cancer cells exposed to PARP inhibitors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nucleophagy selectively removes trapped PARP1 via TEX264-p97-LC3 axis
hypotheses.result: TEX264 directly interacts with trapped PARP1 and links it to LC3 for autophagic degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nucleophagy inhibition re-sensitizes PARPi-resistant cells
hypotheses.result: Disrupting TEX264-p97 pathway increases PARP1 trapping, causes protein aggregates and DNA damage, and increases lethality

title: Solasonine suppresses non-small cell lung cancer progression by inhibiting the STAT3/PD-L1 axis
task: Investigate solasonine mechanism against NSCLC via STAT3/PD-L1 pathway
key_results: Solasonine suppresses NSCLC proliferation, induces apoptosis, inhibits migration/invasion; attenuates IL-6-induced STAT3/PD-L1 signaling; reverses EMT (E-cadherin upregulation, N-cadherin downregulation); PD-L1 overexpression partially rescues phenotype
comments: The partial rescue by PD-L1 overexpression suggests additional solasonine targets beyond the STAT3/PD-L1 axis, warranting mechanistic expansion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Solasonine suppresses NSCLC by blocking STAT3/PD-L1 signaling
hypotheses.result: SS attenuates IL-6-induced STAT3/PD-L1 activation; reduces p-STAT3/STAT3 ratio and PD-L1 expression in tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: PD-L1 is a functional effector of solasonine's anti-NSCLC activity
hypotheses.result: PD-L1 overexpression partially reverses SS inhibitory effects on NSCLC cells

title: FAM111B may promote the progression of lung squamous cell carcinoma through PI3K signaling pathway
task: Elucidate FAM111B role in LUSC progression via PI3K pathway
key_results: FAM111B knockdown inhibits LUSC proliferation, migration, invasion; induces S-phase cell cycle arrest; promotes EMT; FAM111B expression correlates with LUSC but not LUAD
comments: The proposed PI3K pathway mechanism is inferred rather than directly demonstrated; mechanistic validation of the PI3K involvement is needed.

model_io.model: LUSC cells (in vitro and in vivo knockdown)

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAM111B drives LUSC progression through EMT promotion
hypotheses.result: FAM111B knockdown inhibits migration/invasion and suppresses EMT markers

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAM111B regulates LUSC proliferation and cell cycle via PI3K signaling
hypotheses.result: FAM111B knockdown induces S-phase cell cycle arrest

title: Automatic selection of the best neural architecture for time series forecasting
task: Automated neural architecture selection for time series forecasting
key_results: Multi-objective optimization reduces training cost by ~8× via sampling-based Pareto-front exploration; hybrid architectures outperform single-model approaches on accuracy-complexity trade-off
comments: Valuable finding that no universal architecture exists, but evaluation on only four benchmarks limits generalizability claims.

model_io.model: Hybrid architecture search (LSTM, GRU, attention, SSM blocks)
inputs: time series data from four real-world domains (healthcare, energy, climate)

hypotheses.hypothesis: A universally superior neural architecture exists for time series forecasting
hypotheses.result: Rejected; data- and objective-driven design yields task-specific optimal models

title: Maritime urban tracking dataset in harbor environment
task: Maritime urban tracking dataset collection and benchmarking
key_results: MUT dataset comprises 19 tracking scenarios, 8 calibration sequences, 1 mapping and 3 docking scenarios at 30 fps (cameras) and 10 Hz (LiDAR); includes stereo, LiDAR, RTK-GNSS, IMU, and PPK ground truth
comments: Valuable resource addressing gap in maritime perception benchmarks, but paper focuses on data description rather than algorithm performance results.

model_io.model: Autonomous ferry sensor suite (stereo cameras, LiDAR, RTK-GNSS, IMU, polarized rig)

title: Chaotic and complex dynamics expose the limits of counterfactual reasoning
task: Limitations of counterfactual reasoning in chaotic and uncertain dynamical systems
key_results: Even modest model uncertainty or observational noise causes dramatic deviations in counterfactual trajectory predictions; counterfactual sequence estimation reliability degrades in chaotic regimes
comments: Important cautionary finding for applied causal inference, but lacks quantitative bounds on noise/uncertainty tolerance; primarily empirical demonstrations.

model_io.model: Counterfactual trajectory estimation in dynamical systems

hypotheses.hypothesis: Counterfactual reasoning remains reliable in dynamical systems with model and observational uncertainty
hypotheses.result: Rejected; even modest uncertainty causes dramatic deviations, especially in chaotic regimes

title: Path planning based on integrating JPS-Theta* algorithm and improved APF algorithm
task: Robot path planning integrating JPS-Theta* and improved APF algorithms
key_results: JPS-Theta* reduces search time and expansion nodes vs. original Theta*; improved APF generates shorter local paths with better fit to global trajectory
comments: Three-stage pipeline (JPS-Theta*, B-spline, APF) is well-motivated but lacks quantitative benchmarks on standard metrics like path length or computation time.

hypotheses.hypothesis: JPS-Theta* eliminates redundant nodes and improves search efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial reduction in expansion nodes and search time

hypotheses.hypothesis: Improved APF incorporating global path control nodes avoids local optima
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; local path exhibits closer alignment with global trajectory

title: Fault tolerance in para-line network topologies: theory and applications in smart systems
task: Fault-tolerant metric dimension of para-line networks
key_results: FTMD = 3 for n=3 or 6; FTMD = 4 otherwise; fault-tolerant resolving sets minimize cardinality
comments: Solid theoretical result with constructive proofs, though practical validation on IoT/smart city networks is absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Para-line networks derived from n-sunlet networks exhibit consistent fault-tolerant metric dimension patterns
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FTMD follows piecewise pattern dependent on n

title: Large-scale multimodal pre-trained model driven ceramic design knowledge graph construction and cross-domain innovative design reasoning mechanism
task: Ceramic design knowledge graph construction and cross-domain innovative design reasoning
key_results: 47% innovation improvement through cross-domain knowledge transfer; multimodal KG captures design knowledge across text, visual, and 3D modalities
comments: Integrating LLMs with domain-specific KGs is promising but the 47% metric lacks clear baseline comparison context.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-domain knowledge transfer improves ceramic design innovation
hypotheses.result: 47% improvement achieved via domain adaptation and multimodal fusion

title: GraphDL: A visibility graph-based structural representation framework for flow-based cyber-attack detection
task: Visibility graph-based structural representation for flow-based cyber-attack detection
key_results: GraphDL achieves 75.81–96.73% accuracy and 72.32–96.65% weighted F1 on CICIDS2018; graph-derived metrics improve over raw CNN baseline in some configurations but at higher computational cost
comments: Trade-off analysis between structural modeling capability and computational overhead is valuable, though raw CNN baseline often superior suggests visibility graph abstraction may be unnecessary for this task.

model_io.model: Natural Visibility Graph feature extraction + CNN classifier
inputs: network flow data segmented by sliding window

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visibility graph structural representations capture temporal and nonlinear traffic behaviors better than raw flow features
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; GraphDL offers alternative representation but raw CNN achieves higher F1 with lower computational cost

title: Uncertainty-aware spatio-temporal contrastive graph neural networks for cyber financial fraud detection and risk management
task: Spatio-temporal contrastive GNN for cyber-financial fraud detection under extreme label sparsity
key_results: ST-CGNN achieves Precision@100 = 0.884 and calibrated ECE = 0.034 on DGraph-Fin; shared encoder + evidential triage head outperforms sequential modular pipelines; improvements concentrates on datasets with heterogeneity and bursty timing
comments: Multi-task learning with hard-negative contrastive regularizer and evidential output is well-motivated; paired bootstrap testing strengthens statistical claims.

model_io.model: ST-CGNN (continuous-time heterogeneous encoder + contrastive regularizer + evidential head)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared-encoder multi-task learning improves uncertainty calibration and fixed-budget analyst review reliability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ECE = 0.034 demonstrates strong calibration; bootstrap tests confirm enhanced reliability

title: A multi-scale supervised contrastive framework for cross-domain soybean disease classification using leaf and UAV imagery
task: Multi-scale supervised contrastive learning for cross-domain soybean disease classification
key_results: Supervised contrastive framework achieves ~98% UAV accuracy with improved inter-class separability (0.59 vs. 0.19) and reduced domain discrepancy (0.0336 vs. 0.114); zero-shot leaf-to-UAV transfer baseline at 40%
comments: Thorough ablation and embedding analysis; CLAHE + color constancy preprocessing effective, but improvements plateau after fine-tuning.

model_io.model: Multi-scale supervised contrastive CNN (MaxViT/ConvNeXt backbones) + preprocessing pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Supervised contrastive learning aligns cross-scale features better than standard fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inter-class separability +211%, domain discrepancy -70%

title: A large-scale vision foundation model for musculoskeletal radiographs
task: Foundation model for musculoskeletal radiograph analysis via self-supervised learning
key_results: SKELEX trained on 1.2M images; F1 > 0.9 for stability prediction, ~20 meV/atom formation energy accuracy; outperforms baselines on 12 downstream tasks; unsupervised anomaly localization without task-specific training
comments: Impressive scale and external validity, but anomaly localization evaluation limited to bone tumor case; foundation model paradigm well-executed.

model_io.model: Self-supervised foundation model on musculoskeletal radiographs
inputs: 1.2M diverse radiographs spanning multiple conditions and anatomical sites

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining enables strong transfer to diverse musculoskeletal diagnostic tasks

title: The Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) inorganic materials dataset and models
task: Large-scale inorganic materials property prediction via machine learning interatomic potentials
key_results: OMat24 dataset: 110M+ DFT calculations; trained models achieve F1 > 0.9 for stability, ~20 meV/atom formation energy, high accuracy on thermal conductivity/phonon prediction; corrects systematic softening bias of prior models
comments: Impressive dataset scale and reproducibility; leading Matbench-Discovery performance validates architecture improvements, though model details are sparse.

model_io.model: ML interatomic potential trained on OMat24 dataset
inputs: 110M+ DFT calculations across diverse chemistries, materials, configurations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dataset diversity in OMat24 corrects systematic softening bias in prior models

title: Thermal Utilization on Chip
task: Recover and dissipate on-chip waste heat via integrated hydrovoltaic generators
key_results: Temperature reduction (236 nm LED: <40°C; Intel G3220: 93°C → <60°C); 610.70% improvement in energy utilization efficiency; waste heat converted to stored electrical energy
comments: Impressive energy efficiency gain; hydrovoltaic technology integration is pragmatic. Claims of 610% improvement appear inflated relative to conventional metrics; validation on diverse chip architectures and long-term reliability testing needed.

model_io.model: On-chip integrated thermal recovery system (hydrovoltaic generator)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydrovoltaic generators can simultaneously cool and harvest energy from chip waste heat

title: Scalable quantum photonic platform based on site-controlled quantum dots coupled to circular Bragg grating resonators
task: Integrate site-controlled quantum dots with circular Bragg grating resonators for scalable single-photon sources
key_results: 6×6 SCQD-CBG array with 100% yield; 35/36 devices exceed 20% photon-extraction efficiency; best device: PEE=(47.1±3.8)%, linewidth=(1.41±0.22) GHz, g²(0)=(99.58±0.18)%, HOM visibility=(81±5)%, lifetime=(0.80±0.02) ns
comments: Buried-stressor site-control elegantly eliminates deterministic lithography bottleneck; quantitative offset-tolerance characterization and quantum-optical modeling exceptional; end-to-end efficiency (3.4%) remains below commercial thresholds.

model_io.model: Site-controlled InGaAs QD coupled to CBG resonator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Buried-stressor growth enables precise spatial alignment with CBG without deterministic lithography
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 100% device yield with offset-dependent PEE trends

hypotheses.hypothesis: Charge-noise fluctuations depend on emitter-CBG spatial displacement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; modeled via quantum-optical framework

title: Community structure-regulation coupling reveals optimal information diffusion
task: Model information diffusion in complex social networks via community-structure regulation coupling
key_results: Three regimes (no/localized/global diffusion) separated by abrupt transitions; low-cost intervention region identified for targeted spread containment; predictions validated on large cross-platform real networks
comments: COSREF framework elegantly bridges network topology and dynamics; transition characterization and real-network validation strengthen practical applicability, though specific cost-benefit trade-offs remain abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Community structure and transmission regulation are independently tunable
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; interplay produces three distinct regimes with sharp boundaries

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low-cost targeted interventions can contain spread

title: Suppression of coherent light scattering in a three-dimensional atomic array
task: Suppress coherent light scattering in 3D atomic arrays via Mott-insulator ordering
key_results: Strong reduction in light scattering observed; residual scattering from delocalization, Raman processes, saturation-induced inelastic scattering; scattering probes density fluctuations across superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition
comments: First experimental omnidirectional scattering suppression in 3D; residual scattering mechanisms well-characterized; opens route to subradiant states for photon storage and correlation probing.

model_io.model: 3D Mott-insulator atomic array in optical lattice

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ordered 3D atomic arrays suppress coherent scattering omnidirectionally
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; observed in Mott-insulator state

hypotheses.hypothesis: Residual scattering arises only from disorder or non-idealities

title: Unsupervised multivariate analysis of multiple analysis data fusion combining hydrogen distribution and crystallographic orientation image data of vanadium alloy sample
task: Extract crystal-orientation dependence of hydrogen diffusion in vanadium alloys via multimodal data fusion
key_results: Hydrogen diffusion ~2-3× higher in [111] and [101] grains vs [001] orientation; trend consistent across PCA and MCR analysis but invisible in individual datasets
comments: Unsupervised learning on fused EBSD + EDS/SEM hydrogen maps is sound; the synergistic emergence of structure-property relationships only in multimodal space highlights information-theoretic gains from data fusion.

model_io.model: Multimodal image fusion (EBSD + EDS hydrogen distribution)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydrogen diffusion rate is orientation-independent

hypotheses.hypothesis: Grain boundaries and mixed orientations modulate diffusion

title: Photoexcitation of moiré-trapped interlayer excitons via chiral phonons
task: Deterministically excite moiré-trapped interlayer excitons via chiral phonon assistance
key_results: Valley-selective excitation of individual interlayer excitons via chiral E″ in-plane phonons (~23 meV); narrow spectral linewidth and defined helicity; first-principles calculations confirm phonon coupling mechanism
comments: Novel phonon-assisted excitation preserves valley selection rules; phonon energy and symmetry well-corroborated by ab initio; high utility for quantum emitter engineering in TMD moiré systems.

model_io.model: MoSe2/WSe2 moiré superlattice with chiral phonon coupling
inputs: pump laser frequency (resonant with chiral phonon)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chiral in-plane phonons mediate valley-selective interlayer exciton excitation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fixed phonon energy ~23 meV enables deterministic generation

title: Modulating nonlinear optical responses in 3R-MoS2 Fabry–Pérot microcavities
task: Engineer nonlinear optical responses in 3R-MoS2 via Fabry-Pérot cavity effects and absorption
key_results: Second and third harmonic generation modulation by interplay of material absorption, FP effects at fundamental and harmonic frequencies; absorption-limited vs FP-dominated regimes separated by bandgap threshold; design paradigm for van der Waals photonic architectures
comments: Self-consistent framework from linear reflectance through SHG/THG is rigorous; decoupling geometric and material contributions clarifies engineering knobs, though experimental validation across tunable parameters remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear emission is modulated independently by fundamental and harmonic FP effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dominance depends on harmonic photon energy vs bandgap

hypotheses.hypothesis: Above-bandgap harmonics exhibit absorption-limited regime
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; intrinsic absorption dampens harmonic FP effects

key_results: Transcriptional heterogeneity within isogenic populations correlates with survival; rpoS deletion and nutrient supplementation shift cell states and alter survival frequencies
